escena: SCENE (Run and Gun shoot, produce market in Lima, late morning): hard midday sun slants between the market awnings in visible shafts, thick with drifting dust; a camera operator walks backwards filming a vendor, and the photographer PANS with him so the operator stays sharp while the entire market smears into horizontal streaks of colour behind him, caught at the exact moment the vendor throws a cloth over the crates. The operator wears a plain warm-grey work t-shirt. Nobody looks at the camera. 35mm lens at a slow shutter, panning, focus locked on the operator. Everything is completely unbranded, no brand names, no readable text anywhere.

lecho.objeto: the near edge of a wooden produce crate passing right in front of the lens
lecho.tono: DARK in shadow, with subtle texture
